dropletAges.emptyText: No droplets are running, so there are no ages to chart.

tips.INSTALLING: Installing: 4 droplets up for 0 to 5 minutes. The buildtest service is connecting to the droplet over SSH and installing the platform dependencies the build needs, such as the JDK and kompile-cli.
tips.BUILDING: Building: 2 droplets up for 0 to 5 minutes. The droplet is compiling the workspace and running the requested build rules.

tips.TESTING: Testing: 2 droplets up for 5 to 10 minutes. The droplet is running the project's tests.

tips.BUILDING: Building: 1 droplet up for 15 to 20 minutes. The droplet is compiling the workspace and running the requested build rules.

tips.TESTING: Testing: 1 droplet up for 20 to 25 minutes. The droplet is running the project's tests.
Testing: 2 droplets up for 60 minutes or more. The droplet is running the project's tests.

dropletAges.ariaLabel: Droplet ages by lifecycle stage. 0–5m: 4 installing, 2 building; 5–10m: 2 testing; 15–20m: 1 building; 20–25m: 1 testing; 60m+: 2 testing.

runs.runningTooltip:
This run has been running for 22.4s, measured from when it left the pending queue and started executing. Time spent pending in the queue is excluded.
It spent 10.4s pending in the queue before that.
runs.utilTooltip: How much of the test capacity this run held it was actually using, over the run's life. The green line is utilization over the last minute; the green band below it is the capacity that was in use, and the red band above it is the capacity the run held and was not using, so the two together always fill the chart's height. The chart's full height is 100%, and its right-hand edge is now for a run that is still going and its completion for one that has finished. An unfilled stretch is a stretch the run held no chargeable droplet time, which is not the same as a stretch it was idle. Utilization is the time this run's tests were actively running, divided by the time it held droplets — excluding a 5-minute startup grace per droplet — multiplied by the number of tests the coordinator allowed on each droplet. 100% would mean every test slot on every droplet the run held was busy for the whole time it held them. It is measured by the buildtest coordinator, not derived here.
